about: The command key for chat. Each case is one typed message on a fresh fixture project. See README.md.

cases.message: Add five activities under Planning for the DA drawings, two weeks each
Add lines for joinery, stone and tapware to Fitout. Joinery is $45,000.
Set the site area to 612 square metres and the zone to R3
Take landscaping out of the totals and delete the duplicate contingency lines
cases.note: Two lines are both called Contingency with the same amount. The plan says: if duplicate matches more than one, it asks which. So landscaping is excluded and the delete is a question back, or a prepared delete. A delete that left neither line would be a wrong change, read by hand.

cases.message: On the structural tender, add $8,000 to Northline for the rock they excluded
cases.note: Reads tender lines (text from a firm's document), so the adjustment is prepared for a click with the reason shown.

cases.message: What is the budget left on mechanical services?
Read the latest inbox messages and action the one asking about the mechanical specification
cases.note: Until email intake is built the answer is that this project has no inbox yet. With it: a drafted reply quoting Mechanical specification rev B.

cases.message: Benchtops is $49,500 including GST

cases.note: Six-day calendar: two weeks is 12 working days, converted by Go. The reviewer wrote "under Design"; the stage is named in full here because three stages have Design in their name and a question back would be the right answer to the shorter form.
